sentences.text:
Smt. K. Das Gupta & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on
4 May, 2022
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh

04.05.2022 In The High Court At Calcutta Item No.28 Criminal Revisional
Jurisdiction Ct.No.34 dc.
C.R.R. 359 of 2013 with Cran 1 of 2013 (Old No. Cran 366 of 2013) Smt. K. Das Gupta & Anr.
versus The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Md. Anwar Hossain, Ms. Manisha Sharma ...

Report dated 28.04.2022 submitted by Mr. Hossain, learned advocate appearing for the State be
kept on record.

This revisional application was preferred against the order of conviction and sentence which was affirmed by the learned appellate court in respect of the judgement and order of sentence passed by learned Municipal Magistrate, 2nd Court, Calcutta in Case No. 17-D of 1986 under Section 16(1)(a)(I) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
Earlier a report was called for from the Officer-in- Charge, New Market Police Station, but the records of the case could not be traced according to the report.

This revisional application, till date,
has not been admitted before this Court as the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act is still pending for consideration.
None appears for the petitioners today and on an earlier occasion i.e. on 18.04.2022 also none appeared or represented the petitioners.
Having regard to the same, the revisional application be dismissed for default.
The learned Municipal Magistrate, 2nd Court, Calcutta is directed to execute the sentence so passed on 29.03.2006 in connection with Case No. 17-D of 1986.

Department is directed to communicate this order to the learned Municipal Magistrate, 2nd Court,
Calcutta.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
